candidate_relations.reason: The clinical presentation, histopathology (acantholytic keratinocytes, eosinophilic spongiosis, intercellular IgG/C3 deposition), and serology (negative anti-Ro/La, positive ANA but not specific for lupus) are characteristic of pemphigus erythematosus, not cutaneous lupus erythematosus. While both can have photodistributed lesions and positive ANA, the specific findings differentiate them.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pemphigus erythematosus is a distinct autoimmune blistering disease, while cutaneous lupus erythematosus is a different autoimmune connective tissue disease.
